name: qjs_free_value

ownership.argument: This is qjs_free_value, self-anchored by the only QuickJS-internal error string this build keeps. The remaining 12 qjs_* bindings are not self-anchorable here.

provenance.source: Switches on the JS tag: -7 (string) decrements the reference byte at string+11 and frees through the context hook at ctx+4 when it reaches zero, -1/-2/-3 detach the object from the context's cycle list at ctx+92 and free through 0xC279D48, and any other tag logs '__JS_FreeValue: unknown tag=%d' (the only self-naming QuickJS string in this image) with quickjs.c:5636. 1046 callers.

notes: This is qjs_free_value, self-anchored by the only QuickJS-internal error string this build keeps. The remaining 12 qjs_* bindings are not self-anchorable here.
